answer: Give each agent voting credits earned only by finishing checked jobs, and start every new identity at zero. Voting spends credits that refill one per completed job, so a fresh clone has nothing to spend. Peers audit 5% of jobs, cancel credits from faked work, and wipe the balance after 30 idle days. Forging 1,000 voting agents means finishing 20,000 jobs, about 10,000 hours of compute and $8,000 in fees, before one ballot counts. Such a swarm hits its nadir fast, burning cash polishing an opal that never catches light, while a real record hardens like jade under years of pressure.
